findings.title: Inline selectors in AnalyticsPage, ThemesPage, ImportExportPage bypassing named RTK selectors
findings.why_it_matters: Resolved this loop. Three pages used inline useAppSelector(state => state.tier.*) and inline useMemo instead of named, memoized selectors from @tiercade/state.
findings.what_is_wrong: AnalyticsPage.tsx:63-64 used state => state.tier.tiers/tierOrder inline. ThemesPage.tsx:41 used state => state.theme.selectedThemeId inline. ImportExportPage.tsx:108 computed totalItems via useMemo(() => Object.values(tiers).flat().length) instead of selectTotalItemCount.
evidence: apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx:104-106 (pre-loop 27) — tiers var + useMemo replaced with selectProjectName, selectTotalItemCount; useMemo import removed
findings.leverage_impact: Inline selectors duplicate derivation logic already centralized in selectors.ts; named selectors are the single source of truth for derived state.
findings.locality_impact: Derivation logic co-located in pages instead of package-level selector module.
findings.metric_signal: 3 pages, 4 inline selector instances replaced; 1 useMemo removed.
findings.why_weakens_submission: framework_idioms 8.0 residual: pages bypass centralized selector layer already present in @tiercade/state.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Import and use named selectors from @tiercade/state in each page.

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 27 (cap): framework_idioms 8.0→8.5 via RTK selector centralization — AnalyticsPage, ThemesPage, ImportExportPage all now use named selectors from @tiercade/state; ImportExportPage drops redundant useMemo and tiers intermediate variable. 34 suites, 227 tests, all green. Final avg ~8.33. Hard structural blockers remain: implicit global Redux store (state_management 6.5), within-app DAG convention-only (data_flow 6.5).
